blocks.text: As the campaign develops, offerings begin to arrive and Banda holds Khalsa assemblies in which bani, ardās, and the repeated remembrance of Vahiguru give shape to the new order.
People come not only with arms and wealth but with petitions for relief, children, health, and protection, so that Banda’s camp acquires both devotional and public authority.
The page presents Vahiguru remembrance as central to Banda’s legitimacy, keeping his rise within the Guru-given frame rather than allowing it to become merely military.
